The mother of this character is generally regarded as a direct descendant of Mulhaed al-Quyat, the most important of the Ormazdic prophets. Should he ever convert to the Ormazdic faith, their line will be highly regarded in much of Araby, though the relationship of his descendants to the Prophet will be too remote to increase their reputation significantly.

Since the fall of Calif Jaffar, Araby has collapsed into infighting and the Ormazdic faith has no rightful head. A ruler powerful enough and with the right bloodline could claim the title of Calif-al-Umma, rightful Sultan of All Araby...
